Class SpatialReference

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.gdal.SpatialReference
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SpatialReference extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A coordinate reference system of GDAL (OGRSpatialReference). The axis order is the traditional one of GIS (x = easting or longitude, y = northing or latitude), also for EPSG:4326. Close it after use.
